name: Boot log
description: A pixel book drops down a navy-tuned four-shade handheld screen and lands, the way a cartridge logo arrives at power-on.
choices: The handheld bezel with its long bottom-right curve frames a dot-matrix screen; the classic olive shades are retuned from pale sage to brand navy
The book descends in whole-pixel steps with a faint LCD ghost, then holds
motion: Plays once on load: the book descends in whole-pixel steps for about two seconds and stays.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
